confidence: Low. Concrete motives and potential poison/service access exist, but no murder account or evidence of administration has been released.
plausibility_notes: Several donor conflicts plausibly coexist in a museum gala; Artie has the clearest documented personal loss.
Keeping original historical poison and allowing a preparation preview is theatrical and unsafe, but explicitly motivated by donor insistence and conservator objections.
Camera privacy exception and a canceled lighting blackout are distinct; treating them as one outage would be an unsupported shortcut.
A prop collapse and prop glass are plausible staged-event red herrings; canceled performance does not prove any real collapse was staged.
The 6:35 hold and 6:37 mounting finding are slightly awkward chronology, though an initial alert followed by confirmation can explain it.
Many threads and document-only presentation are cognitively heavy, but times, stamps, and custody details give usable anchors.
